capabilities: Rewrite note references in .base files and base blocks on rename
Update link(), [[links]], file.basename, file.name and file.path expressions
Update full paths of every note when a whole folder is moved
Leave bare-name references unchanged when another file still uses the old name
Show a notice describing what changed
disambiguation: It does not rename notes itself; it updates Base references after you rename or move them.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; works on desktop and mobile, no settings, no network access.
intentEvidence: Obsidian updates [[links]] in your notes and properties, but not inside Bases.
motivation: Fixes a forum-requested gap in Bases rename handling; bases produced by the Notion importer break the same way.
problem: Obsidian updates [[links]] in notes and properties on rename or move, but not references inside Bases, so base filters and formulas silently return empty results.

relations.evidence: folder filters (file.inFolder(...), see Base Path Updater for those)

summary: Rename/move companion for Bases that rewrites link(), [[links]], basename, name and path references in .base files and base blocks.
